benchmark_check.name: CSI All Share
benchmark_check.reason: The benchmark checkpoint contains no authoritative expected Market Breadth/Diffusion scorer outputs or raw-breadth-to-score pairs.

candidate_formula_rejected_as_historical.reason: The file explicitly states these are newly authored proposal definitions, not recovered GP V1.1 formulas.

decision.reason: Authoritative historical final scorer semantics are not fully specified. Implementing from the candidate scorer would invent historical definitions.

implementation_result.reason_no_run: No authoritative final scorer formula or expected-output oracle exists; running a newly invented scorer against the benchmark would not validate historical identity.

all_vs_eligible_final_combination.required_definition: Exact historical combination rule for all-universe versus eligible-universe breadth in the final scorer.

clipping.required_definition: Exact clipping/capping rule, bounds and whether clipping occurs before or after aggregation/normalization.

final_score_mapping.required_definition: Exact conversion from normalized/clipped breadth signal to the historical factor contribution described in B as the final 4% mapping, including sign, scale, offset and weighting order.

input_selection.required_definition: Which recovered daily raw outputs feed the historical Market Breadth/Diffusion final scorer: adv_ratio_all, adv_ratio_eligible, both, median_ret_all, state, or another exact combination.

normalization.required_definition: Exact normalization transform, constants/scales, centering and denominator semantics.

output_contract.required_definition: Authoritative output field name(s), numeric range/units, whether output is pre-weight factor score or post-weight contribution, and exact missing/non-finite behavior.

temporal_aggregation.required_definition: Exact lookback/window and aggregation across dates, if any, before normalization.

reopen_requires_one_of: exact historical final-scorer source or executable
same-date authoritative raw breadth -> breadth component score row(s)
same-date authoritative breadth component score -> final/total score row(s)
multiple authoritative historical I/O rows sufficient to uniquely determine the final mapping
